summary: IMM 1294, “Application for Study Permit Made Outside of Canada”, is the form from Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) that asks who you are, what your passport says, where and what you will study, how you will pay for it, and a set of background questions. Each person applying for a study permit from outside Canada fills in one: most upload it in their IRCC secure account, and only a few people may still send it on paper.
